You'll gain confidence, improve your focus, and reap the rewards in everything from your personal life to experiencing greater productivity at work. Anyone from across Chantilly is welcome to join us in learning the ins and outs of Taekwondo! Just fill out the short form below to learn how our Teen and Adult Martial Arts classes can help you! blurb: Highkicks Taekwondo has been serving Northern Virginia's Chantilly, Herndon, Fairfax, South Riding, Sterling, Ashburn and Centreville areas since late 1990’s. We are dedicated to making your Martial Arts experience enjoyable and satisfying, as well as to help you reach your goals. All of our instructors hold master black belts in Taekwondo and have trained for years to qualify as instructors.
